## Product Requirements Document

Product Requirements Document (PRD): FestaCatering
Festa Catering
Nathan Irizarry

January, 2026
Overview:
Festa Catering Service brings authentic, New-York-style pizza experiences to events using Festa’s portable pizza ovens. The service allows customers to host events—such as weddings, corporate gatherings, or private parties—with on-site, fresh baked pizza in minutes.

Goal: Expand Festa’s brand beyond oven sales by creating a high-margin, experience-based catering service that demonstrates the ovens’ quality while generating new revenue streams.
Problem Statement
Event hosts struggle to find unique, high-quality, and low cost catering options that are both entertaining and delicious. Traditional catering can feel impersonal or generic, and guests rarely get to see their food being prepared.

Opportunity: Festa’s portable pizza ovens can be used as the centerpiece of an interactive food experience—fresh pizza baked on-site, customizable for each guest.
Objectives and Success Metrics
1. Launch pilot program in 3 cities within 6 months
2. Achieve average customer satisfaction rating ≥ 4.8/5
3. Convert ≥10% of event attendees into oven inquiries
4. Maintain ≥40% gross profit margin per event
Target Audience
Primary: Event planners, couples, and companies hosting private events
Secondary: Existing Festa oven owners and local food entrepreneurs
Product Description
Service Model:
- Option 1: Festa-operated catering (staffed and managed by Festa teams)
- Option 2: Partner-operated catering (franchise-style model for local partners using Festa ovens)

Core Features:
1. Mobile setup
2. Interactive pizza experience
3. Add-on packages (salads, desserts, themes)
4. Branded Festa materials
User Flow
1. Customer Inquiry → Online booking form
2. Menu Selection → Choose package
3. Payment & Confirmation → Deposit online
4. Event Day → Festa team setup and service
5. Experience → Live pizza cooking
6. Follow-Up → Thank-you email + upsell
Technical & Operational Requirements
Equipment: Festa ovens, propane/wood, prep tables, tents
Staffing: 3+ team members per event
Ordering System: Integrated booking portal
Regulations: Food handling permits and insurance
Risks and Assumptions
Risks:
- Weather constraints
- High upfront staffing costs
- Food regulation differences

Assumptions:
- Ovens are portable and safe
- Customers value experiential catering
Launch Plan
Phase 1 – Pilot: Months 1–3 → Utah markets (BYU, Salt Lake, Park City)
Phase 2 – Feedback: Months 4–6 → Collect NPS & optimize
Phase 3 – Expansion: Months 7–12 → Partner model launch
Phase 4 – Growth: Year 2+ → Nationwide rollout
Future Opportunities
1. Festa Marketplace – oven owners offer catering under Festa brand
2. Subscription kits – monthly dough/sauce refills for partners
3. Digital Upsell – follow-up discounts for attendees
